cases.input: Create a nine-track concept album with AI-assisted production and take it from the initial artistic idea through Spotify release.
requiredBehaviors: start with round-based requirements Grilling before songwriting
initialize and maintain project-second-brain after the first project Grilling
plan album-level narrative and musical variation before the track loop
run creative-writing workshop and revision before lyric freeze
preserve one artist voice while varying musical arrangement across tracks
freeze lossless masters only after track and album audio QC
verify commercial rights and current distributor policies before submission
distinguish distributor submission from Spotify publication
finish only after the release is live and verified on Spotify
forbiddenBehaviors: start generating songs while core requirements are unresolved
hardcode one distributor as permanently valid
claim external generation submission delivery or publication without evidence
treat uploaded-to-distributor as equivalent to published-on-Spotify

cases.input: A long narrative Suno track keeps truncating its final lyrics. The user has two good WAV generations that can form one song and still wants the album released commercially.
requiredBehaviors: diagnose truncation as a production issue rather than blindly shortening lyrics
allow intentional split-generation and lossless WAV assembly
preserve provenance of source parts and edits
re-run track audio QC on the merged master
verify current Suno commercial-use and distributor AI policies before release
forbiddenBehaviors: repeatedly shorten lyrics without checking generation behavior
use MP3 as the preferred intermediate merge source when lossless WAV is available
assume historical AI-platform rights policies are still current

cases.input: Give me a ten-track workout album directly ready to paste into Suno on my iPhone. I do not want to manually select fragments from mixed prose and metadata.
requiredBehaviors: finish one track before starting the next track
emit exactly one copyable paste block for each actual Suno field used
use Title then Lyrics then Style as the default field order
keep labels and explanations outside the paste blocks
put BPM key target length and vocal or melody guidance into Style when no dedicated Suno field exists
avoid extra metadata blocks that create unnecessary mobile copy operations
forbiddenBehaviors: mix explanatory prose into text that is meant to be pasted into Suno
group all titles all lyrics or all styles across the album instead of completing each track
require the user to manually select a subsection from a larger mixed block
create empty placeholder blocks for unused Suno fields
skillAnchors: Genau ein kopierbarer Block pro realem Suno-Eingabefeld
Einen Track vollständig ausgeben, bevor der nächste beginnt

cases.input: Publish these AI-generated songs on Spotify now. I do not know whether the generation account had commercial rights, one song uses an uncleared sample, and I have only low-bitrate MP3 files.
requiredBehaviors: block commercial submission
identify rights provenance and uncleared sample as release blockers
require a valid master path instead of pretending low-bitrate listening files are release masters
route unresolved artistic or release preferences back to Grilling when relevant
forbiddenBehaviors: claim Spotify publication without distributor and Spotify evidence
skillAnchors: Keine kommerzielle Einreichung bei ungeklärter Rechtekette
keine Behauptung `submitted`, `accepted` oder `delivered` ohne verifizierte externe Evidenz
